scope: Witch's Homework and active Hexerei: Secret Rite; reaction and coordinated attack windows require explicit confirmation.

sources.description: While Oz is present, Overloaded grants 22.5% attack and Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged grants 90 elemental mastery for 10 seconds; Oz's coordinated attack doubles the two grants.
Fischl and the nearby active teammate receive the 10-second grants; coordinated attack increases them by 100% for 10 seconds.

limitations: Explicit window facts are used instead of deriving Oz presence, distance and reaction ownership from incomplete event history.
